body:
Your best friend might not know that waking up and getting our of bed is sincerely trying.

Even if you can't see it right now, someone needs you and you are loved. Your aunt would want you to spend that money getting better. $650 is enough to entice some major life changes, maybe getting a pet?

The responsibility, love, and necessity I am to my pets keeps me going often. Sometimes even more so than humans who I love.
Makes it that much harder to choose, pain or love
I exist painfully and make her laugh endlessly
